title: S&P 500 has its best week since early October, up 2.5%, despite hot inflation and Nvidia's CEO quitting
short: Wall Street gains 2.5% despite hot inflation and Nvidia CEO's exit
dek: The S&P 500 had its first winning week since early October. US inflation beat forecasts, the 10-year yield topped 5%, and Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia's chief executive.
card: The S&P 500 rose 2.5% for the week, even as hot US inflation lifted the odds of a December Fed hike to 85%.
